Console capture requested debug, log, info, warn and error levels after each critical gesture and control phase. No managed exception, native abort, GPU fallback or context-loss message was returned.
This is a functional live acceptance, not a browser frame-time or heap-occupancy benchmark. Later successful checks do not retroactively accept the failed 9171e95 release.
